name: ntfy
label: ntfy — ntfy HTTP API
description: ntfy via the official ntfy HTTP API. Base https://ntfy.sh. Docs: https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/. Self-host: OfficialApiNode host is ntfy.sh. Public topics are secrets. listen = JSON/SSE subscribe is not a long-poll on this node — BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One ntfy operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"publish"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: publish | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: topic
schema.description: Topic path segment for publish (required on INPUT or instance config topic when publishing). Example: backups.

schema.label: click
schema.description: URL opened when the notification is clicked.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: publish, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: ntfy access token (Bearer) or leave blank only for public self-host topics you intend to be world-writable. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: topic
configurationParameters.description: Default topic. Public topics on ntfy.sh are guessable — use access tokens.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
